```elixir title="Elixir"
config_value = %TreeSitterLanguagePack.ProcessConfig{language: "sql"}
result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", config_value)
IO.inspect(result.language)
IO.inspect(result.metrics.error_count)

IO.inspect(result.structure)
```
